description: Permanent places open all year anywhere in France (playgrounds, parks, sports courts, skateparks, pools, amusement parks, zoos, libraries, museums and other cultural venues, heritage sites), nearest first. Use it when there is no dated event that fits, or the user wants a place rather than an event. Give a location (near_lat/near_lon) or a town of Île-de-France. Returns up to 10 places.

category.description: Kind of place. Optional: all kinds when omitted.

city.description: Town in Île-de-France, used when no coordinates are given, e.g. "Versailles".

name: find_places
title: Find permanent places nearby
